title: Hearty Charred Australian Lamb Skewers
description: Charred and crispy Australian lamb skewers cooked on a salt block, featuring mustard seeds and a blend of herbs, perfect for a cozy dinner
instructions: Preheat the salt block in the oven at 400 degrees for 30 minutes before cooking
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece
Mix together olive oil, garlic, rosemary, thyme, salt, black pepper, and mustard seeds in a bowl
Brush the mixture onto the lamb skewers, making sure they are fully coated
Place the skewers on the preheated salt block and cook for 10-12 minutes per side, or until charred and crispy
Brush the skewers with lemon juice during the last 2 minutes of cooking
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional rosemary and thyme if desired
